notes.title: Long Time No See is now live!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share spine-tingling news! Long Time No See v1.1.0 has materialized on Steam, and it’s [b]completely FREE to play![/b] 

The Steam release comes full of enhancements from the original Game Jam version to make your ghostly adventure even more exciting:

[list]
[*] Adjust the game to your liking with the brand-new options menu, putting the game’s control right in your hands. Separate volume controls and a text-only mode give you control over your game experience.
[*] Let the story unfold seamlessly with the new Auto-Advance dialogue feature, ensuring you don’t miss a single haunting moment.
[*] Save your progress with the new save/load feature, so you can pick up at the same conversation you left off at! (Line-specific save/load coming in a future update!)
[*] Interact with your favorite characters and experience some all new dialogue!
[/list]

Your [b]reviews and downloads[/b] help us to spread the word about our cozy little adventure, so we’re always thankful for your support! We still have more improvements in store - including more quality-of-life features and localization - so stay tuned!

Thank you all so much for embarking on this journey with us. It’s such an honor to see all of the supportive feedback from this community.

Til Next Time,

Incredulous Interactive (Ryan & Josh)
